name: pi-from-scratch
tagline: 600 lines of TypeScript that build a super-mini pi agent from scratch
description: pi-from-scratch is an educational project that builds a 'super mini pi' agent from scratch in about 600 lines of TypeScript. It demystifies agent architecture by walking through each moving part — tool use, reasoning loops, and model interaction — without the noise of a full framework. With 834 stars in four days, it has become a favorite starting point for developers who want to truly understand how agents work.
highlights: Builds a pi agent from scratch in roughly 600 lines of TypeScript
Demystifies agent architecture piece by piece
No heavy framework — just the core moving parts made readable
834 stars in four days from the learn-by-building crowd
A practical on-ramp to understanding agent internals
curatorNote: Frameworks hide the hard part. This one strips it all away and rebuilds a working agent in 600 lines of TypeScript, which is exactly the kind of transparency that helps people finally 'get' agents. 834 stars in four days says the approach resonates.
